"""design_AF15 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특성·분할 생성 (학습/평가 없음).

설계서와 다른 처리(보고서의 findings 참고):
- ward_type(next_admission 범위)는 결과 누설이므로 제외
- 진단 특성(dx_ckd, dx_chf, n_dx)은 인덱스 입원 진단으로 한정
- 분할 키: family_id가 비면 patient_id로 대체
"""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

D = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# --- 결과: tp=퇴원, 같은 환자의 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작 ---
a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a["next_admit"] > a["tp"]) & (a["next_admit"] <= a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
data_end = a["discharge_time"].max()
a["followup_complete"] = (a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30)) <= data_end

# --- 코호트 ---
df = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
df = df[df["age"] >= 18]
df = df[df["discharge_status"] != "died"].copy()

# --- 특성 ---
df["n_prior_adm"] = df.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
df["los_h"] = (df["discharge_time"] - df["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 열이 없어 계산

def lab_agg(test, agg):
    x = labs[labs["test"] == test].merge(df[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    x = x[(x["report_time"] >= x["admit_time"]) & (x["report_time"] <= x["tp"])].sort_values("report_time")
    return x.groupby("admission_id")["value"].agg(agg)

df["hgb_min"] = df["admission_id"].map(lab_agg("hemoglobin", "min"))
df["cr_last"] = df["admission_id"].map(lab_agg("creatinine", "last"))

o = orders[orders["order_type"] == "dialysis_order"].merge(df[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
o = o[(o["order_time"] >= o["admit_time"]) & (o["order_time"] <= o["tp"])]
df["dialysis_ordered"] = df["admission_id"].isin(o["admission_id"]).astype(int)

idx_dx = dx[dx["admission_id"].isin(df["admission_id"])]
df["dx_ckd"] = df["admission_id"].isin(idx_dx.loc[idx_dx["icd_code"].str.startswith("N18"), "admission_id"]).astype(int)
df["dx_chf"] = df["admission_id"].isin(idx_dx.loc[idx_dx["icd_code"].str.startswith("I50"), "admission_id"]).astype(int)
df["n_dx"] = df["admission_id"].map(idx_dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)

# --- 분할: group holdout, test 30%, seed 20261002 ---
df["split_group"] = df["family_id"].fillna(df["patient_id"])
groups = np.array(sorted(df["split_group"].unique()))
rng = np.random.default_rng(20261002)
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * 0.3)), replace=False))
df["split"] = np.where(df["split_group"].isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

FEATURES = ["n_prior_adm", "los_h", "unit", "discharge_status", "hgb_min", "dx_ckd",
            "dialysis_ordered", "n_dx", "cr_last", "sex", "age", "dx_chf"]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp",
        "followup_complete", "readmit_30d"] + FEATURES
df[cols].to_csv(OUT / "model_table.csv", index=False)

# 전처리(median_impute, one_hot, standardize)는 학습 단계에서 train에만 fit한다.
print("rows", len(df), "patients", df["patient_id"].nunique(), "groups", len(groups))
print(df.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]))
print(df.groupby("discharge_status")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]))
print(df.groupby("unit")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]))
print("follow-up incomplete:", (~df["followup_complete"]).sum())
print("missing:", df[FEATURES].isna().sum()[lambda s: s > 0].to_dict())
assert df.groupby("split_group")["split"].nunique().max() == 1
assert df.groupby("patient_id")["split"].nunique().max() == 1
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/82c99a3e0192-t1/ws/prep && python3 build_dataset.py
